newsitem.title: IRAQ: UAE men bring relief donation to Iraq.
newsitem.headline: UAE men bring relief donation to Iraq.

text.p: A group of young men from the United Arab Emirates (UAE) arrived in Basra in southern Iraq on Wednesday with 300 tonnes of food, medicine and clothes for sanctions-hit Iraqis, the official Iraqi News Agency INA said.

"This initiative is supported and encouraged by UAE President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan who is continuously calling for ending the suffering of Iraqis and lifting the embargo," Mohammad Abdullah al-Shibah, one of the group members, told INA.

The UAE leader, an influential regional player respected by his mediation efforts, has urged reconciliation with Baghdad to ease the suffering of the Iraqi people who have lived under stringent United Nations sanctions since Iraq's 1990 invasion of Kuwait.
